subject: chemistry
content: The correct statements about Cr2+ and Mn3+ is(are) (Atomic numbers of Cr = 24 and Mn = 25)

options.content: both Cr<sup>2+</sup> and Mn<sup>3+</sup> exhibit d<sup>4</sup> electronic configuration.
when Cr<sup>2+</sup> is used as a reducing agent, the chromium ion attains d<sup>5</sup> electronic configuration.

explanation:
The correct statements are as follows:

(A) Cr3+ is more stable than Cr2+, thus, Cr2+ act as reducing agent.

(B) Mn2+ is more stable than Mn3+, thus, Mn3+ act as an oxidizing agent.

(C) Both Cr2+ and Mn3+ exhibit d4 electronic configuration.
